name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – After § 18 – Am 11
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 18a. Calls for an urgent audit of EU development funding and reiterates its call to cease the funding of ideological projects, such as the provision of blenders for food preparation in schools in Africa that do not have electricity, as demonstrated by the 2024 European Court of Auditors special report on the Trust Fund for Africa; recalls that aid must reach the intended recipients and not be used to fuel corruption;
